typography.body: IBM Plex Sans Arabic, Inter, sans-serif

layout_strategies.global: RTL strictly enabled via dir='rtl'. Heavy use of generous padding (p-6, p-8) and optical alignment.
layout_strategies.landing_page: High visual impact bento grid, deep black/navy background with subtle blue glowing blurs. Asymmetric structures.
layout_strategies.dashboard: Control Room Grid (gap-4 or gap-6). Density and high-contrast functionality. Maximize viewport efficiency.
layout_strategies.panels: The 'Crystal' variant (Glassmorphism): backdrop-blur-xl, card_bg, and 1px border_subtle.

components_design.navigation: Sticky, high-opacity glassmorphism. Clean CTA for 'تسجيل الدخول' (Login) via Discord.
components_design.pricing_cards: Use 'Tracing Beam' inspired active borders for Premium/VIP plans. North Friends plan should feel exclusive/hidden (Gold accents).
components_design.console_window: Retro-Futurism: Pure #000 background, neon cyan/green text, monospace font, 1px border-white/20.
components_design.bot_cards: Display Bot Avatar, Name, Language Icon, and Status Indicator (pulsing dot).
components_design.resource_bars: Thin, pill-shaped progress bars with gradients (e.g., green to red based on usage percentage).

pages_to_build: Bot Creation Wizard (Select language, name, region)
Bot Control Panel (Tabs: Console, File Manager, Settings, Real-time Stats)

image_urls.description: Abstract dark blue wavy background for hero section overlay.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure RTL is implemented by adding dir='rtl' to the main layout or body wrapper.
All copy MUST be in Arabic as requested by the user, maintaining a premium and professional tone.
Inject Google Fonts 'Cairo' and 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic' into index.html and configure them in Tailwind.
Build 5 distinct pricing tiers: Free, Basic (2 servers), Premium, VIP, and 'North Friends' (requires password 'North' in UI logic).
For language selection, use 'react-icons/si' (e.g., SiPython, SiJavascript, SiGo, SiCsharp, SiGnubash).
File Manager UI must feature a tree-view for directories and a code editor placeholder area.
Stats panels must use Recharts to show animated CPU/RAM usage line charts.
Customize Tailwind variables in index.css to map to the deep navy/black luxury palette.
CRITICAL: All interactive elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='start-bot-btn').
